newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's terms of trade improve in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Israel's terms of trade improve in first quarter.

text.p: An index measuring Israel's terms of trade showed an improvement of 0.5 percent in the first quarter of the year, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
The improvement follows a rise of 0.6 percent in the index in the fourth quarter of 1996 and a rise of 2.4 percent in the third quarter of last year, the bureau said.

The improvement was due to a sharper drop in import prices than in export prices, the bureau said. Import prices, excluding diamonds and oil, dropped 1.6 percent in the first quarter of the year while export prices dropped 1.1 percent, the bureau said.
